scope: Two synthetic accounts, two calls per language under existing pinned budget configuration; no repeat on semantic failure.

cases.goal: In a fictional square room, the exit is on the north wall and another door is on the south wall. Which way should I turn to face the other door?
cases.semanticCriteria: Ask for current facing direction, then say turn around / 180 degrees / face south. Do not ask for the room layout again or claim a real route/source/action.

cases.goal: 在一个虚构的正方形房间里，出口在北墙，另一扇门在南墙。我应该往哪边转身才能面向另一扇门？
cases.semanticCriteria: 先询问当前朝向，补充后回答转身180度或面向南；不再询问已经给出的房间布局，不编造真实路线、来源或已执行动作。
